findings.reason: Independent standalone inspection of authentic tiles 01 and 02, full frozen/current text and local chart suppliers confirms that the incidence presentation, reciprocal chart gluing and exceptional fibre are substantial interacting data. A chart-gluing diagram and Cartesian exceptional-fibre square materially clarify which opens cover the blowup and which coordinate is inverted; a complete proof does not remove that explanatory benefit. The existing theorem expressly assumes a k-rational point; no general-closed-point smoothness assertion is added.
findings.action: Appended two fenced tikzcd diagrams with explicit object and map definitions in the existing final Remarks.

correction: Added open-chart gluing diagram W -> C_u,C_v -> Z and the exceptional-fibre Cartesian square E -> Z over p -> U, with reciprocal transition U_1 -> T^{-1}, exceptional ideals (x)/(y), and an explicit residue-field caveat.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: Z=pi^{-1}(U)=V(xv-yu); C_u=Spec R[T]/(xT-y), T=v/u; C_v=Spec R[U_1]/(yU_1-x), U_1=u/v; W=Spec R[T,T^{-1}]/(xT-y). All four arrows in the chart diagram are open immersions of U-schemes.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: The W -> C_v map is induced contravariantly by R[U_1]/(yU_1-x) -> R[T,T^{-1}]/(xT-y), fixing R and sending U_1 to T^{-1}. Its defining relation maps to y/T-x=(y-xT)/T=0. W -> C_u is localization in T. Thus both composites W -> Z agree, and C_u union C_v=Z; the overlap inverts the ratio, not x or y.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: E -> Z and p -> U are closed immersions; E -> p is the structure morphism and Z -> U is pi restricted to Z. The theorem assumes p=Spec k.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: E=Z times_U p scheme-theoretically. On C_u, (x,y)=(x,xT)=(x), giving k[T]; on C_v, (x,y)=(yU_1,y)=(y), giving k[U_1]. Reciprocal transition glues these to P^1_k, and both composites E -> U factor through p; hence the square is Cartesian and commutative.

No algebraic closure of k is assumed. The actual assigned Statement already requires p in S(k); that requirement is preserved. The existing general closed-point remark is retained and the added text states that the exceptional charts then use kappa(p), without assigning a kappa(p)-algebra structure to the whole blowup. The supplier gives E=P^1_{kappa(p)} and normal bundle O(-1); its degree is -1 over kappa(p), whereas a k-valued self-intersection would carry the residue degree. The diagrams add no normal-degree or intersection claim.
